articles.title: India Signals Shift from AI Vision to Sovereign Execution with the launch of IAIRO
articles.summary: India has launched the Indian AI Research Organisation (IAIRO) in New Delhi (Jan 30, 2026), marking a decisive shift in its AI journey. This pioneering initiative aims to bolster indigenous AI research and development. For SSB aspirants, it highlights India's commitment to technological self-reliance, crucial for enhancing national security and strategic capabilities across various sectors, including defence.

articles.title: Israel announces plan to reopen Gaza’s Rafah crossing on Sunday
articles.summary: Israel plans to reopen the Rafah border crossing, linking Gaza with Egypt, on Sunday after nearly two years of closure. This move, following international pressure, is expected to allow only a limited movement of people. The partial reopening aims to alleviate some humanitarian challenges in Gaza, highlighting ongoing regional complexities and the critical role of border access.

articles.title: Trump Admin Uses Equity Stakes, New Mines to Secure Critical Minerals Supply Chain
articles.summary: The US administration has aggressively pursued developing new mines for critical minerals and rare earths. This strategic initiative aims to secure vital resources essential for advanced technology and national defense, reducing reliance on foreign supply chains. It underscores a proactive focus on resource independence and supply chain resilience, crucial for national security.

articles.title: Nutriband Inc. provides summary of Annual Shareholder Meeting Key Discussion Points
articles.summary: Nutriband Inc. (NASDAQ: NTRB, NTRBW) issued an update to its shareholders on January 30, 2026, from Orlando, Florida. This corporate announcement provided details on significant milestones and discussions stemming from the company's Annual Shareholder meeting. For aspirants, understanding such market activities highlights the global financial landscape and corporate governance practices.

articles.title: Veteran Indian pilots highlight Russian Su-57’s edge over the US F-35
articles.summary: Former Indian Air Force veterans told RT India that Russia's 5th-generation Su-57 fighter jet is a potent weapon, potentially providing an edge over the US F-35. The advanced capabilities of the Su-57, including its stealth and multi-role functions, are being highlighted amidst ongoing discussions about its strategic importance in modern air warfare scenarios and potential global acquisitions.

articles.title: Stock Market Highlights Jan 30: Sensex ends 296 points lower at 82,269, Nifty skids 98 points to 25,320; markets snap 3-day rally, dragged lower by metal, IT stocks
articles.summary: The Indian Rupee recently hit an all-time low of 92.02 against the US Dollar before paring losses to close at 91.97. This significant depreciation reflects ongoing economic pressures, making it a crucial indicator for SSB aspirants to understand. Such currency fluctuations can impact trade, inflation, and national economic stability, highlighting the importance of staying informed on domestic and international financial developments.

articles.title: Fearing ICE, Native Americans rush to prove their right to belong in the US
articles.summary: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) operations in Minneapolis led Choctaw Nation citizen Shane Mantz to prepare his tribal identification. This situation highlights the intricate relationship between federal immigration enforcement and the sovereign rights and unique citizenship status of Native American tribes within the United States, raising questions about identity amid national policies.
